svg.title: Figure 12 · Position limits create changes in active constraints
svg.desc: Benchmark moments, 0 ≤ wi ≤ 60%, sum wi = 1. Feasible expected returns run from 7.6% to 12.4%. Weights are continuous and piecewise affine in this convex quadratic problem; corners occur when constraints enter or leave the active set.
